title: Dashboard and Mission Control Liveness — Activity Feed and Live Tool Output
goal: Make the Dashboard show real recent activity instead of empty tiles, and make Mission Control show live tool stdout during a running scan instead of showing output only after the task finishes.
scope: Two changes: (1) DASHBOARD ACTIVITY FEED: add a Recent Activity section to the Dashboard that shows the last 10 audit events from the audit_events table for the selected engagement. Display: event timestamp, action label (human-readable: run started, finding created, scan completed, report generated), and engagement name. Pull from GET /api/v1/dashboard which already returns data. Add activity_feed array to DashboardRead schema with last 10 events formatted as {timestamp, label, icon}. Render in Dashboard module below the stats tiles. (2) MISSION CONTROL LIVE STDOUT: currently task stdout only appears after the task status changes to completed. Change Mission Control to poll GET /api/v1/tasks/{task_id} every 3 seconds while a task is running (status=running), compare stdout_lines count, and append new lines to the terminal panel incrementally without clearing the panel. Add a Live indicator (pulsing dot) next to the terminal heading while the task is running. This gives operators visibility into what a scan is doing right now.
generation_reason: Dashboard shows 0 in all tiles for empty engagements and has no activity feed. Mission Control terminal is empty during active scans and only fills after completion. Both make the system feel static.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Activity feed and live stdout polling only. No websocket upgrade in this slice.

success_criteria: Dashboard shows Recent Activity feed with last 10 events for selected engagement.
Activity feed shows human-readable labels (not raw action strings).
Mission Control terminal updates incrementally every 3s while task is running.
Live indicator (pulsing dot) shown next to terminal heading during active task.
No regression in terminal display after task completes.

acceptance_criteria: Dashboard activity feed shows events. Mission Control terminal updates live during scan.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
